concerns.text: Spec's ModelResult key attributes include `confidence_interval`, and US-2 scenario 3 requires the forest plot to show 'the fixed effect estimate with 95% confidence intervals'. The plan's ModelResult schema (model_output.schema.yaml) has no CI field, and Phase 7 (`08_visualize.py`) says only 'generates ... association_forest.png from the real model outputs' without specifying 95% CIs. Add a CI field (or SE-derived CI) to the model output contract and name it in the forest-plot phase.

SC-002 requires the system to 'correctly apply the alpha threshold of 0.05 to flag significance in the PGLS output'. The plan pins alpha=0.05 in config.yaml and research.md labels analyses exploratory, but no plan element produces an explicit significance flag in the model output (model_output.schema.yaml has p-values but no significance column). Add a significance-flag output tied to config alpha so SC-002 is measurable.
